title: Same numbers. Same thing?
同樣的數字，就是同一件事嗎？
One full turn: what has actually returned?
轉完一圈，到底什麼回到了原位？
Two paths, one meeting point
兩條路，同一個會合點
Can you shrink both loops to a point?
兩個圈，都能縮成一點嗎？
Two half-and-half results need not make the same pair
各自都是一半，配在一起也相同嗎？
A possible mathematics, or a measured world?
數學上能寫，自然界就一定如此嗎？
Keep the direction and the plane
把方向和它張成的面，一起留下

question: Suppose the computer shows [1, 0]. Before calculating anything, what does that pair describe?
假設電腦只顯示 [1, 0]。還沒開始算以前，你得先知道：這兩個數字在記什麼？
arrow: One unit right, none up. Change the measuring axes and the coordinates must change.
向右一單位、向上一點也沒有。換一組量測方向，分量就得改寫。
temperature: 1 °C and 0 °C. Turning your head does not mix those two readings.
1 °C 和 0 °C。轉過頭看，不會把兩次讀數混在一起。
try: Turn the grey axes through 90°. The arrow stays still; its description changes from (1, 0) to (0, −1).
把灰色量測方向轉到 90°。箭頭不動，描述卻從 (1, 0) 變成 (0, −1)。
insight: The missing ingredient is the transformation rule. A geometric tensor includes that rule; a PyTorch tensor supplies storage, and our program supplies the interpretation. A spinor can use the same array storage with a different rotation rule.
差別就在變換規則。幾何張量連這條規則一起考慮；PyTorch 的 tensor 提供儲存空間，意義則由程式補上。旋量也能放進同一種陣列，只是旋轉規則不同。
legend: $\theta$ is the angle through which the measuring axes turn; $v_{\mathrm{new}}$ is the fixed unit arrow expressed in those axes.
$\theta$ 是量測方向轉過的角度；$v_{\mathrm{new}}$ 是同一支單位箭頭在新方向下的分量。

invariance: First recall the tensor promise: turn the measuring axes, and the numbers may change, but the physical quantity stays the same. Changing coordinates changes how we describe nature, not nature itself.
先記住張量的基本承諾：轉動量測座標，分量數字可以改變，但描述的物理量不變。換座標只是換一種說法，自然界並沒有因此改變。
rotationDistinction: Now ask a different question: keep the measuring axes fixed and actually rotate the system. Ordinary spatial tensors return after 360°; the electron’s spinor state vector needs a different rotation rule.
接下來換個問題：量測座標不動，實際旋轉系統。普通空間張量轉 360° 會復原；電子的旋量態向量，則需要另一套旋轉規則。
question: An ordinary arrow comes back after 360°. Does an electron’s state keep any record of that turn? Try the two dials before looking at the answer.
普通箭頭轉 360° 就復原。電子的狀態，會不會還記得剛才那一圈？先試兩只錶盤，再看答案。
try: Press 360°, then 720°. Compare the direction hand with the half-speed phase hand. The right dial is a phase sketch, not a tiny spinning electron.
先按 360°，再按 720°。比較方向指針和半速的相位指針；右邊示意的是波的相位，不是電子裡有顆小球。
stateIntro: Write the state vector as $\psi$. Its sign follows this sequence:
用 $\psi$ 記錄態向量，它的符號會這樣走：
insight: A spinor follows this rotation rule. An ordinary spacetime tensor returns under a full spatial turn; a spin-½ state vector changes sign. To describe the electron we need that extra mathematical structure, even though a computer can still store its components in an array.
遵守這種旋轉規則的紀錄叫旋量。普通時空張量轉一整圈會復原，自旋 ½ 的態向量卻會變號。描述電子時，要補上這種數學結構；電腦依然能用陣列儲存它的分量。
reveal: If the sign changes, why do ordinary probabilities stay the same?
變號了，為什麼一般的測量機率沒變？
answer: A global sign leaves every squared amplitude unchanged. A relative sign can become visible when a rotated branch interferes with an unrotated branch. A sign change is not a mirror reflection.
整體變號不改變振幅的絕對值平方，所以單看機率看不出來。讓轉過的分支與沒轉過的分支干涉，才可能看見相對符號的影響。變號也不等於鏡像反射。

story: Split an electron wave into two paths around an inaccessible magnetic flux, then bring them together. The magnetic field can vanish along both paths, yet the interference pattern can shift. Looking only at the field along the paths has missed something.
把電子波分成兩路，繞過無法進入的磁通區，再讓它們會合。兩條路上的磁場可以都為零，干涉條紋卻仍可能移動。只看沿路的場強，少記了什麼？
try: Press Play or move the slider. The loop stands for the two paths joined into one closed route. Flux stays at $0.25\,h/e$: after one turn, the electron phase is $-90^\circ$; after two, $-180^\circ$.
按播放或拖動滑桿。把兩條路接成封閉圈來看：磁通固定為 $0.25\,h/e$，電子繞一圈後相位為 $-90^\circ$，兩圈後為 $-180^\circ$。
local: Field strength describes the local electromagnetic field.
場強告訴你當地的電磁場。
route: A comparison rule tells us how phase is carried and accumulated.
沿路比較的規則，告訴你相位怎麼帶過去、累積起來。
name: That comparison rule is a connection; the net change around a closed route is called holonomy. The Aharonov–Bohm effect makes the distinction concrete: local field values and loop phase contain different information.
這條比較規則叫聯絡（connection），繞封閉路徑後的總變化叫 holonomy。阿哈羅諾夫與玻姆的實驗把差別變得可見：局部場值和繞路累積的相位，提供不同資訊。

challenge: Here are two sheets. One has a hole. Predict which loop will get stuck, then try shrinking them together.
這裡有兩張紙，其中一張有洞。先猜哪個圈會被卡住，再把兩個圈一起縮小。
try: Drag “Shrink the loops”. Stay on the paper: no cutting, jumping over the hole or leaving the surface.
拖動「把圈縮小」。規則只有一條：一直留在紙面上，不能剪開、跳過洞或離開表面。
local: Both sheets can look equally flat near your feet.
腳邊的一小塊，兩張紙都可以一樣平。
global: Only one loop can collapse to a point. The hole is global information.
只有一個圈能縮成一點。有沒有洞，是整體資訊。
insight: Topology records features that survive smooth stretching. Quantum materials can also have global topological distinctions, often calculated by accumulating local geometric data. The missing ingredient is global structure; local tensor calculus remains useful. The paper is an analogy, not a literal picture of the material.
拓撲記錄平滑拉伸後仍保留的特徵。量子材料也可能有整體的拓撲差異，常能由局部幾何資料累加算出。要補的是全局結構，局部張量微積分仍然有用。紙上的洞是比喻，不是說材料真的有一個肉眼可見的洞。

question: Each particle gives 0 or 1 with equal probability. Is that enough to predict how the pair behaves? Switch between the two preparations below.
每顆粒子量到 0、1 的機會各一半。這樣就足夠知道整對粒子的結果嗎？切換下面兩種準備方式看看。
caption: Joint probabilities: rows are A, columns are B
共同結果的機率：列是 A，欄是 B
marginal: A alone: 50% / 50%. B alone: 50% / 50%. These separate probabilities are identical in both preparations.
單看 A：各 50%；單看 B：也各 50%。兩種準備方式的個別機率完全一樣。
insight: The separate probabilities miss the relationship. A tensor product provides the shared space for the pair’s state, including entangled states that cannot be split into two independent states. Entanglement is therefore not a failure of tensor products.
個別機率少記了兩者的關係。張量積提供整對粒子的共同狀態空間，也能容納無法拆成兩份獨立狀態的糾纏態。所以糾纏不是張量積的失效。
caution: 這張表就能證明糾纏嗎？
answer: No. Matching prewritten cards can reproduce this one-basis table. Bell experiments compare several measurement settings to test stronger quantum correlations. Neither observer can choose an outcome to send a faster-than-light message.
不能。預先配好的卡片，也能重現單一基底下這張表。貝爾實驗要比較多組量測設定，才能檢驗更強的量子關聯。任何一方也不能挑選結果來超光速傳訊。

lead: A beautiful mathematical rule can suggest a physical model. Whether nature follows it is another question. Keep three levels separate:
漂亮的數學規則，可以啟發一個物理模型；自然界是否採用它，還是另一個問題。先分開看三層：

title: A mathematical rule
數學規則
body: For ordinary numbers and Clifford algebra, moving brackets does not change a product: (2×3)×4 = 2×(3×4).
普通數與克利福德代數遵守結合律：(2×3)×4 = 2×(3×4)，移動括號不改答案。

title: A proposed physical model
候選物理模型
body: Some quantum-gravity and string-background models explore noncommutative or nonassociative rules.
部分量子引力、弦論背景模型，探索非對易或不滿足結合律的規則。

title: An experimental claim
量測證據
body: These proposals have not established that observed spacetime has those properties.
這些提案還沒有確立：已觀測的時空確實具有那些性質。

takeaway: Clifford algebra is associative. It is not a universal replacement for every speculative algebra or for tensor methods. Ask what a model predicts and what observation could test it.
克利福德代數本身滿足結合律，不是替代所有候選代數或張量方法的萬用工具。接著該問的是：模型預測什麼，又能用什麼觀測檢驗？

question: What if multiplying two arrows kept both how much they align and the oriented patch they span?
如果兩支箭頭相乘，能同時留下「平行程度」和「張成的定向面積」呢？
try: Try 0°, 90° and 180°. When the arrows become perpendicular, alignment vanishes while area is largest. Parallel arrows do the opposite.
依序試 0°、90°、180°：兩支箭頭垂直時，平行部分消失，面積卻最大；平行時則相反。
explanation: The dot $a\cdot b$ keeps alignment. The wedge $a\wedge b$ keeps oriented area, called a bivector. The geometric product $ab$ keeps both:
內積 $a\cdot b$ 留下平行程度，外積 $a\wedge b$ 留下定向面積，後者叫雙向量。幾何積 $ab$ 把兩者一起保留：
closing: This gives us a route into planes, rotations and spinors. It adds useful geometric structure; connections, topology and the quantum state still have their own jobs.
這給了我們一條走向平面、旋轉與旋量的路。它補上有用的幾何結構；聯絡、拓撲與量子態，也仍有各自要做的工作。
